title: DAMA Tier-1 Models
subtitle: CPU models of the DAMA Memory Agent: retriever, decision heads, write-op classifier
description:
# DAMA Tier-1 models

The small CPU models of the DAMA Memory Agent (Dual Agent Memory Architecture). One version per checkpoint (L1.x); the
version notes carry the label. Private.

| Variation | What | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `other/tier1` | CPU bundle: retriever (bge-small, fine-tuned), decision model (MiniLM-L6: rel / sal / need / route), op model (DeBERTa-v3-xsmall: ADD / UPDATE / DELETE / NOOP), tokenizers, `runtime.py`, `dama_tier1.json`, plus `CHECKPOINT.json`, `report.json`, `calibration.json`, `code_snapshot.zip` | `dama_agent.load_tier1(folder)` (only numpy + onnxruntime + transformers tokenizers) |
| `transformers/tier1-pytorch` | the trained PyTorch models (`retriever/`, `decision/`, `ops/`) | continue training without starting over |

| Model version (`other/tier1`) | Checkpoint |
|---|---|
| 1 | L1.1 |
| 2 | L1.2 |

Produced by the notebook `s41r4j/dama-tier1-training`; code in the dataset `s41r4j/dama-code`.
